ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: loss_logsigmoid_delta_regret_exp_weighted_advgap_v2
ir.intuition: The original loss was insensitive to the objective due to using exp(clamped advantage_gap) which grows slowly and saturates, resulting in negligible gradient variation. We fix this by replacing the exponential weighting with a softplus applied to advantage_gap, creating a smooth, unbounded positive weight that grows more gradually and sensitively with advantage_gap. This preserves probabilistic pairwise preference loss but improves sensitivity to objective signals and ensures stable scalar output.
ir.pseudocode:
lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
weight = batch['weight']
delta = lpw - lpl
prob_loss = -logsigmoid(delta)
pos_weight = softplus(adv_gap)
loss = prob_loss * pos_weight * weight
final_loss = mean(loss)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    weight = batch['weight']
    delta = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    prob_loss = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(delta))
    pos_weight = ops.softplus(adv_gap)
    loss = ops.mul(prob_loss, pos_weight)
    loss = ops.mul(loss, weight)
    return ops.mean(loss)
